name: Union Bank of India
title: Union Bank of India - 532477 - Transcript Of Post Earnings Call Held On April 23, 2026

read.thesis: Union Bank's Q4 FY26 call shows NIM down to 2.64% QoQ on rate cuts, LCR squeezed to ~114%, and deposits up only 2.72% YoY; management guides 13-14% credit growth and says NIM can be defended, with no capacity lever at play.

triggers.label: NIM 2.76% → 2.64% QoQ
triggers.quote: our NIM from 2.76 to 2.64, it is only 12 basis points

triggers.label: Credit growth 13-14% FY27
triggers.quote: we would like to maintain around 13% to 14% credit growth

triggers.label: Bulk deposit blended ~6.9%
triggers.quote: the blended rate for the quarter was a little less than 7, around 6.9 or so

triggers.label: Evasion on AFS and PSLC
triggers.quote: Right now it is not. We will assess it because the entire portfolio has to be seen

guidance.quote: we would like to maintain around 13% to 14% credit growth

guidance.value: around 1% general guidance for the year
guidance.quote: we say around 1% we keep as a in general guidance for the year

red_flags.label: Standard-asset buffer top-up and ECL shortfall ~INR 4,300 cr
red_flags.quote: we are on the same INR 4,300 crores

evasions.quote: Right now it is not. We will assess it because the entire portfolio has to be seen

evasions.topic: Bulk deposit / CASA ratio on IBPC
evasions.quote: I am saying not raised but the resources which we have tried to build
